definitions: A state of nervous excitement, confusion, or distress; a dither.

blocks.text: Sarah Elizabeth "Tizzy" Lockman is an American politician and member of the Democratic Party. She serves in the Delaware Senate representing District 3, which covers parts of Wilmington, including the downtown and Riverfront areas.
El-A-Kru is an Antiguan soca band. The name derives from "Little Antigua Crew".
